title: Yeet
blurb: Originating as a dance in a 2014 Vine and mutating almost immediately, yeet is now the internet's official projectile-launching sound and one of very few memes to make it into actual dictionaries. The word does a lot of work: it implies force, indifference to landing site, and a certain joy in the act itself. Play it the instant anything becomes airborne — a water bottle, a controller after a bad loss, a bin bag aimed hopefully at a skip, your responsibilities at four o'clock on a Friday. Short, loud, perfectly stupid.
origin: From a 2014 Vine; became the universal sound of throwing things enthusiastically.
